history.question: What are the NovaCred V1 Blocked SSN exception conditions?
history.answer: For NovaCred V1, this concerns an active Blocked SSN result at Prescreen prequalification. Prequalification and full underwriting are separate stages, and a rule that permits continuation does not itself establish final approval. The relevant result must be interpreted using the lender and version that governed the evaluation; rule identifiers are not severity rankings. These points identify the setting before describing the exception. [NovaCred_UW_V1_pdf.pdf::0006] The block must be a resolved administrative duplicate older than 48 months, the current identity comparison must be exact, and a clean secondary identity source must corroborate the match. All conditions are required; continuation is not approval. [NovaCred_UW_V1_pdf.pdf::0008]

history.question: In one Prescreen prequalification evaluation, an active exact Blocked SSN with no applicable exception and an active Credit Freeze both fire. Which codes and dispositions must be retained, and how should immediate routing and skipped work be recorded for NovaCred current version?
history.answer: For NovaCred V1 Prescreen, retain Code 101 with NOAA for Blocked SSN and Code 105 with RFAI for Credit Freeze. Both fired in this scenario, so both are evaluated results. [NovaCred_UW_V1_pdf.pdf::0007] [NovaCred_UW_V1_pdf.pdf::0030] No Blocked SSN exception applies, so processing cannot continue through that block. [NovaCred_UW_V1_pdf.pdf::0008] Preserve both results with their source data, timestamps, actions, policy version and reviewer/system identifiers. [NovaCred_UW_V1_pdf.pdf::0038] A later rule genuinely not run after a terminal outcome may be logged as not evaluated with its skip reason; that does not turn the already-fired Credit Freeze into a skipped evaluation. Do not invent the order in which these two rules ran. [NovaCred_UW_V1_pdf.pdf::0006]
